extraction.summary_en: This filing records a président's decision (29 Jan 2013) to transfer ARCHEAN TECHNOLOGIES' registered office and updated statutes reflecting that change; it contains no new capital operation. The updated statutes' "Apports" article (art.6) recalls the company's capital history (founding capital, then successive increases in 2005/2006/2008) and article 7 restates the current capital of 368,102 EUR split into 217,241 category-A and 150,861 category-B preference shares.

evidence.quote_fr: PROCES-VERBAL DES DECISIONS DU PRESIDENT DU 29 JANVIER 2013 Le vingt neuf janvier deux mille treize,

snapshots.as_of_basis: Capital article (art.7) of the statutes as updated by the président's decision of 29 January 2013.

evidence.quote_fr: ARTICLE 7 - CAPITAL SOCIAL Le capital social est fixé à la somme de 368.102 euros. Il est divisé en 368.102 actions de 1 euro chacune entièrement libérées. Il est divisé en actions de préférence de catégorie A et en actions de préférence de catégorie B, à savoir : 217.241 actions de préférence de catégorie A, 150.861 actions de préférence de catégorie B.

issues: Article 6 (Apports) states that on 27/06/2008 the nominal value of shares was divided by 100 (capital unchanged at €200,000, split into 200,000 shares of €1 each); this is a par-value change, not a capital event, so no CAPITAL_INCREASE/DECREASE was recorded for it, only noted here.

The statutes' Apports history article does not name the subscribers or specify the method (numeraire/apport en nature/incorporation de reserves) for the 2005, 2006 and 2008 increases; these are inferred as 'autre' due to lack of detail.

Two dates conflict for the statutes update: the cover page (p3.11) and the president's decision header (p2.14) both give 29 January 2013, but the final signature line (p28.6) states 'Statuts mis à jour par décision du président en date du 9 janvier 2013' — likely an OCR error for '29 janvier 2013', but flagged as a discrepancy.

No holder names or individual shareholdings are given anywhere in this filing; only the split between category-A and category-B preference shares is stated, so holders_complete is false and no shareholder-level events could be extracted.
This filing itself (siège transfer) contains no capital operation; the capital-related content is entirely restated history from the accompanying updated statutes.
